objective: Generate broad reach, attributable DUFYND traffic and measurable merchant clickouts without paid production.

measurement_contract.rule: Merchant clickouts are not sales. Transactions, commission and revenue remain null until verified network evidence exists.

selection_logic.principle: Reach x purchase intent x zero-spend executability
selection_logic.external_signal_note: 2026 TikTok trend reporting explicitly maps perfume discovery into contexts such as date night and first-date preparation; current fragrance community discussion also shows recurring engagement around blind buys and gifting.

content.hypothesis: A polarizing but broadly understandable 'outdated vs still works' question creates more comments and qualified product curiosity than another feature-led 1 Million post, while the direct product landing converts that curiosity into measurable product views and merchant clickouts.
content.hook: 1 Million 2026: ausgelutscht – oder immer noch ein Komplimente-Magnet?
content.format: 15-20s fast opinion/reaction short plus optional 4-slide photo-mode cut; new edit, not a repost of one_million_example61_01

execution.beat_2: 2-7s: 'JA: bekannt, süß, sofort erkennbar' / quick visual punch
execution.beat_3: 7-13s: 'ABER: Bekannt heißt nicht automatisch schlecht' / occasion framing
execution.beat_4: 13-17s: verdict: 'Wenn du auffallen willst: diskutabel. Wenn du genau diesen DNA willst: immer noch relevant.'

content.cta: Team 'immer noch stark' oder Team 'vorbei'? Duftprofil + aktuelle Kaufoptionen bei DUFYND prüfen.

measurement.primary_success_signal: attributable merchant clickouts without sacrificing retention

decision.KEEP: After a clean measurement window: three_second_retention >= 0.70 AND completion_rate >= 0.30, OR at least 1 attributable merchant clickout from >= 10 tagged DUFYND sessions.
decision.ITERATE: three_second_retention >= 0.55 but completion_rate < 0.30, or comments are strong but tagged DUFYND sessions are weak; change only opening 2s or CTA/landing placement.
decision.KILL: After 2 hook variants: three_second_retention < 0.55 AND completion_rate < 0.20 AND 0 tagged DUFYND sessions.

content.hypothesis: Framing the gift problem as 'there is no universally safe perfume' creates stronger sends/shares and gift-advisor intent than a generic Top-3 gift list because it solves a common Q4 anxiety instead of pretending one bottle fits everyone.
content.hook: Der größte Fehler beim Parfum-Verschenken? Nach dem 'sichersten Duft' zu fragen.
content.format: 20-25s carousel/photo-mode or short assembled from existing gift_for_him_safe_to_bold_01 scene assets; no new generation
platforms: YouTube Short from existing scene stack

target_product.commerce_role: high-intent Q4 traffic capture; product recommendation remains user-value-led

content.cta: Sag DUFYND, für wen du suchst – Geschenkstil statt Blind-Buy-Roulette.

decision.KEEP: shares_or_sends rate >= 0.015 OR >= 10 tagged DUFYND sessions with downstream product views; keep theme and test 'für sie' or budget variant next.
decision.ITERATE: retention is healthy but shares/sends are weak; tighten problem statement and make the 3 style choices more instantly recognizable.
decision.KILL: After 2 hook variants: three_second_retention < 0.55 AND shares_or_sends rate < 0.005 AND < 5 tagged DUFYND sessions.

content.hypothesis: A simple 'pick 1/2/3 by vibe' mechanic combines broad date-night relatability with a low-friction comment prompt and sends high-intent users into the fragrance finder.
content.hook: Date Night: Welchen Typ willst du ausstrahlen – 1, 2 oder 3?
content.format: 18-24s choice short using existing top3_date_01 scenes; text-first, optional operator voiceover

target_product.commerce_role: occasion-led discovery traffic that can resolve into eligible live product pages and merchant offers

content.cta: 1, 2 oder 3? Deinen Date-Night-Stil bei DUFYND finden.

decision.KEEP: comment rate >= 0.015 OR completion_rate >= 0.35, plus >= 8 tagged DUFYND sessions; expand into winter/date-night follow-up.
decision.ITERATE: comments are strong but sessions weak; make CTA earlier and more concrete. Sessions are strong but retention weak; shorten to 15-18s.
decision.KILL: After 2 hook variants: completion_rate < 0.20 AND comment rate < 0.005 AND < 5 tagged DUFYND sessions.
